articles.title: Bluejay Diagnostics Advances Rapid Biomarker Testing For Sepsis Patients
articles.summary: Bluejay Diagnostics Inc. (NASDAQ:BJDX), through its Symphony near-patient diagnostic platform, on Tuesday revealed foundational clinical data from its SYMON-II validation trial. The company utilizes its Symphony near-patient diagnostic system to analyze interleukin-6 (IL-6). Researchers investigate this biomarker to determine its connection with 28-day mortality risk among critically ill individuals suffering from sepsis and septic shock.
